generic.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
generic.invalidResponse: The service returned an invalid response.
generic.crypto: An identity or key operation failed.
generic.notFound: The requested item was not found.
generic.conflict: The operation conflicts with the current state.
generic.permissionDenied: The app does not have permission to write to this location. Check the cache or receive-directory permissions, or choose a writable folder and try again.
generic.unknown: The operation failed. Please try again.

transfer.sourceChangedResume: The source file changed. Resuming will retransmit the current version: {{file}}
transfer.sourceMissingResume: The source file is missing. You can finish with the received files or cancel: {{file}}
transfer.sourceUnavailableResume: The source file is temporarily unavailable. Resume to try again: {{file}}
transfer.noFiles: There are no files to send.
transfer.connectionUnreachable: Could not reach this device. Make sure NodeSend is open on the other device and both devices are on the same network.
transfer.connectionRefused: The other device refused the connection. Make sure NodeSend is running and check the firewall settings.
transfer.receiveDirectorySpace: There is not enough space in the receive directory, including space reserved for other tasks. Free disk space or choose another receive directory, then try again.
transfer.timedOut: The connection timed out. Make sure the other device is online and check the network and firewall.
transfer.cacheSpacePaused: The cache drive ran out of available space, so the task was paused. Free space on the cache drive, then resume the task.

settings.favoriteSaveFailed: Could not save favorites. Check the app's available storage and try again.
settings.invalidLanguage: The selected language is not supported.
settings.unfinishedTransfers: The transfer protocol has changed. Complete or cancel all unfinished transfers before installing the update.
settings.pauseTransfers: Pause active transfers before installing the update.

update.desktopOnly: Updates are available only in the desktop app.
update.manifestIncomplete: The Android update manifest is incomplete.

preview.nativeRequired: This preview action requires the native service. It will not connect to devices or read or write real files.
